reignFields.raw: 28 February 202{{efn|According to Liu Bang's biography in the ''[[Book of Han]]'', he was crowned emperor on the ''jiawu'' day of the second month of the fifth year of his reign, inclusive of his reign as King of Han. This corresponds to 28 February 202 BC in the proleptic Julian calendar.}} – 1 June 195 BC

{{circa|March 206}}{{efn|According to Liu Bang's biography in the ''Book of Han'', he was created King of Han in the second month of the first year of his reign, inclusive of his reign as King of Han. This corresponds to 12 March to 10 April 206 BC in the proleptic Julian calendar.}} – 28 February 202 BC
